title: I made an browser idle RPG where everyone idles together (free, browser)
author: Slapbox98
selftext:
Hey everyone,

I've been building Evertrail Idle, an idle RPG you play in the browser on PC or phone.

The twist is that you don't idle alone. Everyone lives in one shared town, so when you go chop a tree or fish off the shore, the other players doing the same thing are right there with you. Busy spots actually look busy.

The idle part works like you'd hope: pick a skill and your adventurer keeps at it while you're away. Come back later and the logs, ore and XP are waiting.

What's in right now:

\* 17 skills that feed into each other (logs go to fletching, ore to smithing, fish to cooking, herbs to potions)        
\* Combat with melee, ranged and magic, plus bosses        
\* Exploration trips with a scout and a riverboat        
\* Clans with clan bosses, a player-run market, chat and leaderboards

It's free, no download, and you can start as a guest in a few seconds:          
https://evertrailidle.com

It's an open alpha, so it's rough in places and I'd love feedback. What makes you keep coming back to an idle game?

Discord if you want to follow along: https://discord.gg/9P82zm3bdK
